findings.claim: Deep mission pool is pruned twice per tick (outer call + first line of replenish_mission_pool), each prune allocating a fresh HashSet, plus a double sort — all in the unconditional post-discovery tick path
findings.correct_value: Confirmed at commit 86dddc3; fixed by removing the redundant outer prune (replenish prunes first and pruning is idempotent/RNG-free) and replacing the HashSet with an allocation-free kept-prefix duplicate scan over the <=7-entry pool; double sort left in place because ensure_emergency_supply_run observes pool order between the two sorts
